rationale: Setup is the only binding limit: every worst setup path is at ss 100C 1.60V, while hold (+0.08-0.11 ns), slew/cap (0-18 pins vs bar 89) and final DRC (0) never bind. Port-touching paths limit loose-target runs; tight runs are mostly reg-to-reg. The best run (md5 setting: AREA 3, ABC buffering+sizing, timing-driven placement, both post-GRT repairs, cap213, util 30) reached 4.669 ns yet kept +0.301 ns slack, above its 0.09 ns post-GRT margin, with the lowest DRC and wirelength near estimate, so it was not pushed. Setting 1: same flow at 4.5 ns with slightly larger margins. Setting 2: identical but DELAY 3 synthesis (second-best run used it; DELAY 4 failed), isolating synthesis.
